content.title: Lyrical Lemonade Announces 2026 Summer Smash Lineup - Chicago Today
content.text: Got story updates? Submit your updates here. ›The vibrant 2026 Summer Smash festival will bring the latest and greatest in hip-hop, trap, and electronic music to the Chicago area.Chicago TodayLyrical Lemonade has unveiled the lineup for its 2026 Summer Smash festival, which will take place June 12-14 at SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview, Illinois. The three-day event will feature headlining performances from Skrillex, Playboi Carti, Lil Uzi Vert, Yung Lean, Bladee, and Chicago's own Chief Keef, along with dozens of other top hip-hop acts. Why it matters Summer Smash is one of the most anticipated annual music festivals, drawing tens of thousands of fans from across the Midwest and beyond to experience the latest in hip-hop, rap, and electronic music. The festival's return to the Chicago area after a pandemic-related hiatus is sure to energize the local music scene and provide a major economic boost to the region. The details Tickets for the 2026 Summer Smash festival will go on sale on Tuesday, April 14 at 2 p.m. Central Time. In addition to the headliners, the lineup includes performances from Fetty Wap, Sexxy Red, Lil Baby, Waka Flocka, G Herbo, and more than a dozen other artists. The three-day event will take place at SeatGeek Stadium in Bridgeview, Illinois, just outside of Chicago. Tickets for Summer Smash 2026 go on sale on Tuesday, April 14 at 2 p.m. Central Time.The festival will take place June 12-14, 2026. The players Lyrical LemonadeAn independent media company and music festival organizer that has grown to become one of the largest platforms for hip-hop and rap music in the United States.SeatGeek StadiumA multi-purpose stadium located in Bridgeview, Illinois, just outside of Chicago, that will host the 2026 Summer Smash festival.
